_help: Copy to .claude/docs/services.json. One entry per limit the usage watch checks (.claude/scripts/usage-watch.mjs). probe = a command that prints the amount used so far this period (a usage API, a CLI, or the app's own counter, rule L-4); leave it out when the service has no way to ask, and check by hand. period: monthly (with resetDay) or daily. noLimit: true only when Salem said so. Phone alerts: set the key NTFY_TOPIC in .env.local.
